rationale.authored_short: A one-line acknowledgement or confirmation; templatable or system-generated.
rationale.authored_medium: A paragraph with specifics (meter numbers, volumes, deal numbers) and a lookup or two; lookups and framing can be pre-filled, the judgement stays human.
rationale.authored_long: A multi-paragraph write-up or pasted data; reports and pasted tables can be generated, narrative cannot.
rationale.forward: Open, add a one-liner, pick recipients; routing rules and shared queues replace it.
rationale.chaser: Re-find the thread and restate the ask; a chaser exists only because there is no tracker, and reminders remove it.
rationale.read: Open, skim, decide; FYI copies can be replaced by a status board, action items still need reading.
